blocks.content:
Municipalities manage urban areas.

Types of Municipal Bodies:
• Nagar Panchayat – Transitional areas
• Municipal Council – Smaller urban areas
• Municipal Corporation – Large urban areas

items: Match the type of municipal body with its jurisdiction: Nagar Panchayat for transitional areas, Municipal Council for smaller urban areas, and Municipal Corporation for large urban areas.
Questions often test the categorization of urban local bodies based on the size and nature of the urban region.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Municipalities serve as the urban local governance bodies.
Nagar Panchayats are established for transitional areas moving from rural to urban status.
Municipal Councils manage governance operations in smaller urban areas.
Municipal Corporations are constituted to administer large urban areas.
